page-ink-soft.why: was #a3b1c4, hand-picked and not in dd's palette; now the site's muted text (5.46:1 on the page, 4.63:1 on inputs)

page-link.why: was #7cb8fb, hand-picked; now the site's link blue (7.31:1 on panels)

ink-soft.why: was #a3b1c4, hand-picked; now the site's muted text

link.why: was #7cb8fb, hand-picked; now the site's link blue

accent.why: was #fbbf24, the site's prefers-contrast:more amber; now its default amber

focus.why: was #fbbf24 (the high-contrast amber); now the site's own focus ring color

font-body.why: was var(--dl-font-b,...), which needed the captured site CSS; now the stack itself, so the room needs no site stylesheet

font-display.why: as font-body: the resolved site stack

font-mono.why: as font-body: the resolved site stack

radius.why: was 10px, between the site's two radii; now its standard --r

page-bg.why: the room sits on dd's own page (--dl-bg); identity.backdrop gives that color for the contrast check

on-accent.why: text on amber buttons; the site file has no on-amber color (9.22:1 on --dl-amber)
